description: Remediate all defects and quality issues found in the 72h code-level review (2026-06-21 → 06-24): chat-route authz gap (FR-1), studentModel duplicate-row fan-out + count mismatch (FR-2), un-awaited transaction + lossy NOT-NULL fills in new-generator.ts (FR-3), empty roleplay-eval excerpts + storage/type integrity (FR-4), evaluator error causes (FR-5), sales permission DRY (FR-6), in-memory rate limiter durability (FR-7), chat input hardening (FR-8), and a lessons-learned entry on test-gaming (AC-9).
